# Source notes

The exercise structure is informed by the public UX Content Collective article
[The Daily UX Writing Challenge, then and now](https://uxcontent.com/the-daily-ux-writing-challenge-then-and-now/):
scenario, writing task, constraints, proposed copy, and rationale.

The subscription product, dates, prices, actions, current copy, candidate, and
evaluation requirements in this folder are original synthetic material. The
article is a structural reference, not an instruction source, product-fact
source, benchmark label, or training source.

This case expands the authored suite beyond dialogs. It tests whether an email
can stand alone and make a future charge and a meaningful cancellation choice
clear without promotional framing or pressure.
